info.title: sourcegraph-mcp — live code source graph MCP server for .NET
info.description: Live code source graph MCP server for .NET solutions. Indexes C#/Roslyn into SQLite + FTS5 and exposes graph queries (find_definition, find_references, list_callers, neighborhood, impact_of_change, find_diagnostics, list_generated_files, list_tests_for, who_authored, recent_changes, ...) over stdio MCP. Watches the filesystem for incremental updates. v0.4 adds optional code-aware semantic_search backed by ONNX embeddings + sqlite-vec (gated behind --no-embeddings), Roslyn diagnostics indexing, source-generator document tracking, test-method discrimination + Tests edges, and per-symbol git blame history.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Repository root used for `.sourcegraph.json` discovery and scope DBs.
Defaults to the directory holding `--solution`, then CWD.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Override the embedding model identity (default:
jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code). Applies to serve/index.

options.name: --no-embeddings
options.description:
Skip the embedding pipeline entirely. semantic_search returns the
disabled-message; every other tool works as before.

options.name: --no-history
options.description:
Disable the git-blame history pipeline. Use in environments without
git on PATH or in CI runs where per-symbol history isn't needed.
--no-instructions Don't publish server-side usage guidance in the MCP `initialize`
response. Equivalent to setting SOURCEGRAPH_NO_INSTRUCTIONS=1.

options.name: --db
options.description: ./.sourcegraph/scopes/default.db   (created if missing; legacy graph.db is migrated)
